mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stop falling and stabilize near current levels, commuter presence in Manhattan supports more weekday shopping trips and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks. The mechanism fails if retail remains flat while commuting proxies recover.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT rise or stabilize for four weeks but RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to the prior four-week mean, reject the commuting-to-retail mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated above its current level while TRANSIT remains depressed, stay-at-home time increases neighborhood substitution and reduces discretionary retail visits. This pushes RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -50 while RESIDENTIAL stays above +15
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains below -50 and RESIDENTIAL remains above +15 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC rises instead of falling, reject the substitution mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility signals better weather or outdoor activity, which diverts time away from indoor retail and weakens retail-and-recreation visits over the next week. The effect should show up quickly and then fade if PARKS reverses.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 8 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -47.9 to -38.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS rises by 8 points or more in a week and RETAIL_REC does not fall within the following week, reject the outdoor-substitution signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous deterioration in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates tighter activity restrictions or risk avoidance, which suppresses discretionary retail demand over a four-week horizon. Retail should lag the mobility shock rather than move immediately.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall below their t-0w levels for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both weaken for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC improves over the next 28 days, reject the restriction channel.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently negative GROCERY_PHARM mobility implies households are consolidating trips and limiting in-person errands, which spills over into lower retail-and-recreation visits over the next two weeks. The mechanism is not active if grocery mobility normalizes first.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed below -25 across all four weeks
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains below -25 yet RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks, reject the trip-consolidation spillover.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS rebounds and TRANSIT remains weak, people spend more discretionary time outdoors or locally rather than in retail corridors, cutting retail-and-recreation mobility within four weeks. The effect depends on the outdoor rebound exceeding the transit drag.
candidate_trigger: PARKS is above -40 while TRANSIT stays below -55
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above -40 and TRANSIT stays below -55 for four weeks but RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior four weeks, reject the diversion mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: A continued gap between WORKPLACES and RESIDENTIAL indicates remote work and home-based time are still dominant, which keeps downtown retail demand suppressed over the next four weeks. Retail should improve only after WORKPLACES rises and RESIDENTIAL falls meaningfully.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES stays below -45 while RESIDENTIAL stays above +15
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES remains below -45 and RESIDENTIAL remains above +15 but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, reject the remote-work suppression hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lived improvement in GROCERY_PHARM followed by a worsening in PARKS signals a shift from outdoor activity back to indoor errand consolidation, which should lift retail-and-recreation mobility after about one week. The signal is strongest when the two moves occur in opposite directions.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises while PARKS falls in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -34.1 to -27.3 while PARKS improved from -47.9 to -38.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM rises while PARKS falls in the same week but RETAIL_REC does not increase in the following week, reject the reversal signal.
